notes.stack: Main stack name, e.g. python or node-ts.
notes.cmd.install: Dependency install command, run from the repo root.
notes.cmd.build: Build command; leave empty if there is no build step.
notes.cmd.test: Command that runs the full test suite.
notes.cmd.test_one: REQUIRED. Runs the tests of one file; {file} is the path relative to the repo root.
notes.cmd.lint: Lint command for the whole repo.
notes.cmd.typecheck: Type-check command; leave empty if the stack has none.
notes.cmd.format: Command that formats ONE file with {file}.
notes.cmd.run: Command that runs the application on a dev machine.
notes.cmd.migrate: Migration command; leave empty if there is no database.
notes.formatters_by_ext: File extension → format command containing {file}; the hook runs it after every edit.
notes.structure.tests: Test folder, or 'colocated' if tests sit next to the code.
notes.structure.allowed_new_file_roots: CLOSED list of places where agents may create new files.
notes.naming.test_file: Test file name pattern; {name} is the module name.
notes.test.skip_markers: Test-skip marker strings; one appearing in a diff is a blocker.
notes.protected_paths: Globs no agent may edit: secrets, lockfiles, vendored code, prod config.
notes.ci.runner: CI runner/image; pin the version when possible.
notes.ci.setup: Command that prepares the CI environment before lint/test.
notes.deploy.smoke: Smoke test command run after deploy.
notes.deploy.prod_requires_reviewer: Always true: prod needs a human approver.
notes.ui: true if there is a UI; qa will use UI-checking tools.
notes.tracker: Where issues are tracked: github, gitlab or none.
notes.plugins.recommended: Recommended plugins, as name@marketplace; onboard only prints the install command.
notes.notes: Slot → one-line note; flags uncertain values.
notes.packages: Monorepo: folder → partial profile override; leave {} if not a monorepo.
